label: a pronoun in front of a postposition (mere liye, mere sath, mere pas)
note: mere liye, mere saath and mere paas are taught together as one pattern by HI-C84-mere-liye and HI-C84-mere-paas. The oblique the note said was untaught is the chapter's central insight: chapter 2 taught mere as the PLURAL of mera, and it is also the oblique, so -aa becomes -e in front of any postposition. Identical spelling, two jobs, and only what follows tells you which.
